54c2606c: ;
 .;This routine is used to update the ATTENDING PHYSICIAN field (#.1) in
 .;the MEDICAL TREATMENT FILE (#393). It contains the following tags:
 .;
 .;DE  - Entry Action
 .;W   - Output routine for a word-processing field
 .;O   - Output routine for a data dictionary field
 .;TR  - Input Transform
 .;A   - Selects a new DR level
 .;B   - Branching routine
 .;RE  - Handles Reader entry
 .;N   - Handles null responses
 .;RD  - Handles special characters
 .;T   - Value look-up routine
 .;P   - Handles DIC(0)="P" lookups
 .;V   - Processes the new response
 .;Z   - Stores the new response
 .;X   - Handles errors
 .;QS  - Processes extended reader help
 .;D   - Creates the DQ(DQ) array
 .;Y   - Reader entry
 .;PR  - Processes previously edited values
 .;R   - Follows DINUM and DILIST links
 .;RP  - Final processing for responses
 .;I   - Selects the input transform
 .;BEGIN - Initializes the routine
 .;1   - DR input template for .1 field
 .;2   - Allows continuation to another routine
 .;X1  - Place-holder for developers to update
38db7aa3: ;Call the DE tag and then branch to BEGIN
0e5f17d5: ;Set variables used in the reader
01d40e9a: ;If .01 node exists, set DE(1) to contents of 10th piece.
755e7540: ;Kill off utility variable.
be9e4b73: ;Write a data label based on piece position and Fl(1).
3b118007: ;Return after writing the data label.
3982293b: ;Print the user's response on a new line if longer than 45 chars.
ce86ad41: ;If response is not word-processing, check for right margin wrap.
b333f7bb: ;For INACTIVE FIELDS, display and return.
e00c73a6: ;Read the user's response, time-out after DTIME.
574fa530: ;Return after reading the response.
11d632e2: ;Store the DR level and increment the DR level counter.
24a9f81c: ;Branch to the proper DR level.
08224114: ;If DE(DQ) exists, go to PR code. Otherwise, output prompt and read.
3b8ba9d9: ;If X is null and DV does not contain 'R', go to A. If X is null and DV contains 'R', go to X. If X is null and D is less than or equal to 0, go to A.
c8d0a342: ;If X starts with '?', go to QS. If X contains '^', execute D and go to ^DIE17.
0b417cb3: ;If X is '@', execute D and go to Z^DIE2.
96ba50b6: ;If X is a space, DV contains 'd' and does not contain 'P', and ^DISV(DUZ,"DIE",DLB) exists, set X to the value of ^DISV(DUZ,"DIE",DLB). If DV does not contain 'D' or 'S', write '  '_X.

d970ac01: ;Go to M^DIE17 if DV contains 'M', go to ^DIE3 if DV contains 'V', go to P if DV does not contain 'S'. Execute ^DD(DP,DIFLD,12.1) if it exists. Set % to the part of DU after the ';_X_:' and before the next ';'. Set Y to X. If % is not null, execute DIC("S") if it exists. If DIC("S") returns true, write '  '_% if DB(DQ) does not exist, and go to V.

ae3d5ab9: ;Loop through the semicolon-separated pieces of DU. For each piece Y, set DG to the position of ':_X' in Y. Go to X if Y is null. Set YS to Y and Y to the part of Y before the ':'. If DG is true, execute DIC("S") if it exists. If DIC("S") returns true, quit the loop if DG is true.
01b22d77: ;If DB(DQ) does not exist, write the part of YS starting from DG to the end. Set X to the part of YS before the ':'.

fd6f3c09: ;If DV contains 'P', set DIC to U_DU, DIC(0) to 'EN' or 'NM' based on DB(DQ), and 'L' if DV does not contain "'". If DIC(0) contains 'L', set DLAYGO to the second piece of DV after 'P'. If DV does not contain '*', execute ^DIC. Set X to +Y and DIC to DIE. Go to X if X is less than 0.
623995ab: ;If DV does not contain 'N', execute D. If the length of the part of X after the '.' is greater than 24, kill X and go to Z.

0d3c3114: ;If the second piece of DV after ',' is true, X contains '.', and the fifth piece of DQ(DQ) after 'U' does not contain '$', set X based on removing leading or trailing zeros and converting to a number if there is no decimal part.
55481f43: ;Execute the label 'X'_DQ and kill YS.
90d0cdff: ;Kill DIC("S") and DLAYGO. If X exists and is not U, set DG(DW) to X. If DV contains 'd', set ^DISV(DUZ,"DIE",DLB) to X. Go to A.
f983f2f8: ;Write '*7' and '??'. If DB(DQ) exists, go to Z^DIE17.
bea82da4: ;Set X to '?BAD'.
4d3d333c: ;Set DZ to X, execute D, execute QQ^DIEQ, and go to B.
85a4bcfb: ;Set up variables used by ^DIE utilities.
a09823aa: ;Respond to the user
b970a768: ;Execute X2 code.
e378afb8: ;Cross reference setup.
4df75b82: ;Cross reference setup.
d19eefc9: ;Set Y from the set of multiple entries in X.
ce6e16e7: ;Finish up if OK entry.
08daefb2: ;Input transform.
6e837895: ;Check the MUMPS INPUT Transform on X.
e1a01809: ;END OF INPUT TRANSFORM.
3c17c92b: ;Initialize variables
6a947cd9: ;Define DD field characteristics.
b750296e: ;Set up dictionary input.
a26f1bdf: ;Set Initial Value of X.
ba46a5f7: ;Set Initial Value of Y.

91912a7b: If null data is not allowed for this field, ask for re-entry. Otherwise, store the data.
